summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 700KB payload unrelated to babel preset
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod+x's the bun binary, and then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (marked '// @bun @bun-cjs', using shuffled string-array obfuscation via a rotator function and hex-mangled _0xNNNN identifiers) that is only executable under Bun and would not be evaluated by a normal Node analysis of the package. The package's stated purpose is a babel preset whose actual preset entry point (lib/index.js) is roughly 19 lines exporting a preset factory; the Bun runtime fetch and the large obfuscated bundle are unrelated to that purpose and are undocumented. The pattern — pulling an alternate runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling payload from an otherwise legitimate-looking scoped package — matches the fingerprint of a maintainer-account or publish-token compromise injecting a loader/stealer into a downstream dependency.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
